pages.title: Two-handed firepower
pages.text: The Energy Lance is a longer relative of the Energy Sabre. Right-click to fire a laser like those used by Combat Drones.$(br2)Keep your off hand completely empty. A shield, torch or any other item prevents firing.$(br2)A laser deals 30% more raw damage than a fully charged ordinary sabre hit. It fires once per second, needs no ammunition and has no durability. Basic firing needs no fuel; enabled upgrade modules draw power from a carried Energy Holder.

pages.title: Configure with 0
pages.text: Hold the lance in your main hand and press the armor configuration key, normally $(thing)0$(). Install, remove and toggle modules, assign hotkeys and check the holder’s total stored power at the bottom. Refill through the Energy Holder’s own panel or Automatic collection.$(br2)Supports $(item)Energy Efficiency$(), $(item)Power$(), $(item)Inhibit$(), $(item)Looting$() and $(item)Fire$(). Power boosts laser damage; Inhibit strips beneficial effects and suppresses Master Soldier regeneration. Looting and Fire apply to laser hits.$(br2)Carry a fueled holder. An occupied off hand stops the modules.

pages.title: Obtain a lance
pages.text: Use the matching Energy Lance blueprint in a Constructor or Auto Constructor. The blueprint is reusable.$(br2)Materials: Energy Sabre, Advanced Circuit, 10 Silver Ingots, 5 Negarite Dust, 5 Posirite Dust, 2 Platinum Ingots and 2 Lithium Ingots.$(br2)With ArienteWorld installed, lances and their blueprints are rare Storage Cube loot. Some soldiers and guards carry them: use cover against their ranged fire.
